_note: Project specification registry — the values Agent 3 validates measurements against.
PROVENANCE: these entries are not invented for this file. They are the spec
values already used elsewhere in this repo, consolidated into one canonical
place so the compliance agent reads a stored spec rather than receiving one
inline from whoever calls it. The rebar entry is the same 150mm +/-10mm
figure seeded into the RAG corpus and the ComplianceEvent rows by
standard_ref is the governing document AS RECORDED ON THE PROJECT. Agent 7
retrieves the actual clause text from the ingested PDFs at validation time;
this field is a pointer, not a substitute for that retrieval.
If no entry matches, Agent 3 returns status 'no_spec' and declines to issue a
verdict. It never falls back to a default tolerance -- a made-up tolerance
produces a real-looking PASS/FAIL on nothing.

specs.description: Project-wide default rebar spacing where no zone-specific schedule exists.
